items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Fletcher Henderson was in the Grand Terrace, with Chu Berry, $35 a week.

ctx.x: That’s right. And Fletcher Henderson was at the Grand Terrace, $35 a week, with John Kirby on bass, trumpet player.

items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That‟s the reason I happen to know about him being with Fletcher Henderson.

ctx.x: He can really sing it. But when you find out, like at my age I know how to… he was… Fletcher Henderson… was a rehearsal pianist.
